notes.title: Demo Update – New Level + Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]We’ve rolled out a new update for the demo! This patch tackles a number of bugs and also introduces a brand-new fast-paced level. It’s completely optional, but we hope you’ll give it a try and have fun with it.[/p][h3]Highlights of this update:[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Level[/b]: [i]Intro City → Grass[/i] – a fast-paced experience added to the demo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements[/b]: Adjusted interface on entry for a smoother start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Transitions[/b]: Cleaner fade-ins and improved loading flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silver Nuggets[/b]: Now rewarded when re-doing an already completed cave puzzle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rail System Update[/b]: Adjustments made, though speed is still tied to FPS. If rails feel too fast, set your FPS to [i]Max 60[/i] in the settings menu and back out to apply.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Virtual Cameras[/b]: Now highlight which areas you’re moving into.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And More[/b]: Several smaller improvements under the hood, with plenty more on the way![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for checking out the demo and sharing your feedback—it really helps shape the game as we continue development![/p]

notes.title: Wishlist now! Capri Care in the works
notes.content:
Since a small project in September of 2024 this project has grown quite a bit up until now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438557/8476c1acdd56b9923e79f0290d4eba8196040f5d.jpg[/img]

Several features have already been added to the game 'albeit needing polish'.

These features include

[list]
[*] Capri Consumables
[*] Creature Consumables
[*] Birth
[*] Rebirth
[*] Breeding
[*] Individual Stats for overall Capri performance
[*] Color Modification
[*] Patterns
[*] Dig Puzzles
[*] Fly Puzzles
[*] Tree Growth
[*] Plant Growth
[*] Fishing
[*] Creature Capture Mechanics
[*] Capri Creation through Incubation
[*] Racing
[*] Tug of War
[*] Treasure Hunt
[*] Matching Game
[*] The first 2 Gardens
[*] The first 2 Open Area
[*] Area Requirements

[b]Calculated Behaviors affected by:[/b]
[*] Allegiance
[*] Happiness
[*] Hunger
[*] Personality Trait

[b]Capri Box allowing management of:[/b]
[*] Cosmetics
[*] Capri Garden Location
[*] Return Capri
[*] Viewing Stats
[/list]

and more to come!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438557/fda6ac2dfaaed13a37da58b2ca3bac67cbc68d92.png[/img]

Currently I am working on implementing more minigames for the 2nd Area in the game, getting some more graphical assets and creating more cosmetics.

But in the meantime the game is available for wishlist and as more and more development is done I will do my best to keep the news rolling.

Thank you for visiting, 
Thank you for wishlisting if you did
and thank you for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438557/9482fca213b160662769a97b9468e9d7a9ecdf62.png[/img]
